commits.subject: fix(payments): remediate dispatch and closure workflows

delivered_scope: Organization-scoped canonical full-Order BRL PaymentIntent with immutable amount snapshot and versioned lifecycle
single active hosted-checkout PaymentAttempt enforced by PostgreSQL, deterministic Order-first locks, 90-second leases, persistent sanitized retry control, and per-event failure isolation
manager-tier idempotent creation, checkout request, verified cancellation, explicit reopen/provider switch, reconciliation, and Order cancellation coordination
Mercado Pago Checkout Pro and Pagar.me Payment Links contract builders behind adapters with external effects disabled
Mercado Pago signature, five-minute replay window, Redis rate limiting, authenticated request-ID replay key, authoritative resource loader, pre-fetch deduplication, and generic responses
Pagar.me callback disabled in code and by PostgreSQL constraint until authenticity is independently established
ORM and PostgreSQL-protected immutable financial snapshots plus sanitized status/webhook evidence and closed AuditEvent/OutboxEvent schemas
dispatch eligibility revalidation and preservation of valid external evidence when Order, intent, or provider-account context changes during I/O

cancellation commands correlated to one exact attempt and outbox event, with terminal consumption, persistent processing backoff, and canonical paid, mismatch, unknown, cancelled, expired, and failed evidence handling

manager-only external evidence, OPERATOR masked visibility with active hosted-link access, server-rendered HTML, manager-tier tenant-scoped read-only admin, executable provider-network blocking, tasks, documentation, and clone continuity

Celery autodiscovery for Payments, isolated direct-exchange bindings for default and integrations, explicit Compose workers for both queues, and an executable agenda-route-registration-consumer topology gate

organization_isolation.evidence: Organization-explicit services/selectors/workers, active Membership policies before provider I/O, Order-PaymentIntent-PaymentAttempt lock order, same-Organization provider-account/resource resolution, callback organization derived from its route account, manager-tier tenant-scoped admin, and direct cross-tenant/cross-account/concurrency tests.

provider_contracts.mercado_pago: Checkout Pro request builder matches a versioned official-contract fixture; signed callback validation, authenticated replay key, authoritative-resource injection, deduplication, rate controls, and disabled network effects passed direct tests.
provider_contracts.pagarme: Payment Links v5 builder uses required payment_settings and cart_settings from a versioned official OpenAPI fixture; callback remains disabled by design.
provider_contracts.network_blocking_evidence: Autouse Payments fixture rejects DNS resolution for known Mercado Pago and Pagar.me provider hosts; direct test passed.

deferred: provider credentials, sandbox calls, public callback registration, real charge, production activation, and deploy
Appmax and Pagar.me callback activation pending a complete authenticity contract and Security Review
partial payment, split, multi-currency, automatic fallback, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, fees, interest, settlement, receivables, and accounting
transparent checkout, card capture/tokenization, subscriptions, recurring billing, saved cards, and Messaging delivery
public API, importers, inventory, fiscal, Dashboard, Coolify, homologation, cutover, and later phases
risks: Coverage is 85.25%, narrowly above the 85% gate; Review must still prioritize direct financial, callback, isolation, idempotency, lease, cancellation, concurrency, and Celery topology paths.
The callback rate limiter depends on Redis and intentionally fails closed when cache is unavailable; operational alerting belongs to homologation.
Pagar.me callback authenticity remains unresolved and is therefore blocked in both application and database contracts.
No sandbox evidence exists because external calls were explicitly outside the approved implementation checkpoint.

human_approval.evidence: Explicit human approval after Review 05 APPROVED and final QA/Security GO, followed by explicit authorization to create PR #8, merge Phase 05, and record the official state.
human_approval.note: Provider activation, sandbox, release, deploy, and Phase 06 implementation remain separate checkpoints.

merge_ci.failed_gate: approved phase ancestry and governance baseline
merge_ci.note: The merge arrived on main before this authorized closeout could advance approved_phase_head from Phase 04 to Phase 05; PR #8 had already passed the complete workflow on the exact merged head.

approval_record.celery_runtime_topology: Payments tasks registered; default and integrations workers healthy with exclusive direct bindings
